title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.003665370499 (+3.18696811e-7 over #7624, common U)
body:
## Result

This source-bound contact moves the 902/1091 interaction from chart 618 to chart 373 and removes one paid MOVE on #7624. For the unchanged 17-call signed caller, the complete paid count falls from 110,060 to 110,043, with 22,461 targets and surplus 1,424 unchanged. The local directed application supports **κ ≥ 0.003665370499 under the explicit stronger common U**; the lower-minus-#7624-upper margin is `318696811/10^15`.

The scientific source is #7624 at `3f231831e0bff0cc5241ec89e122d99132bddf52`, with baseline main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Candidate canonical SHA-256 is `df521d552dc35de6271e67655e4f9c466bc9247d37a5196b85613870209106a2`. The package preserves the exact five edits, complete source and candidate evidence, 502-path signed-completion closure, nested predecessor closures, and source notices. [PROOF.md](research/p104-contact902-1091-on7624/PROOF.md) states the zero-normalized-row argument and verification boundaries.

Task `p104-side-correction`, scope **changed**: qualify the fixed published contact on the 204-lifetime #7624 source. The nearest overlap is #7625 on #7623 (180 lifetimes); its gain is not added to this result. #7624 already includes the 902-at-595 stay-drop. This package supplies its missing contact, zero-changed-CLEAR comparison and fresh complete validation.

## Assumptions and scope

Both source and candidate require the five inherited framework assumptions and a **stronger unimplemented common U**. U covers the whole private extent and reachable numerical residuals, atomic return and nonaliasing; the already charged 4,000-unit lifetime item must cover all assigned work. The model retains 32 scalar services per INIT/CLEAR, a normalized coefficient `2^20` per service, all original width, size and precision factors, and precision context cap 4,096. No actual provider, implication from #7624's original erasure premise, same-original-premise dominance, unconditional multiplication theorem, or selected-frontier adoption is claimed. The six matched-base CLEAR changes already present in #7624 remain an inherited applicability question; the contact preserves its exact owned rows and CLEAR forms.

The retained first gate compares 204 CLEARs, 700 owned interfaces, 455 owned scalar-stream operations and one COPY. The corrected checker distinguishes all remaining live rows from nonzero-row metadata and checks both 204-certificate sets. Native coverage includes the fixed 1,075-pair source/complete union, 1,073 candidate pairs and 12 changed-route pairs, with 512 forward and 512 adjoint columns. The signed check covers 17 calls, 3,112 protected-generator catalogue cases, 104 boundaries and 58 outer predicates. Catalogue coverage is not a separate independent inventory oracle. The seven-check source resource branch is derived from paired fresh native calculations; the source catalogue was not rerun, and the captured intermediate files are author observations, not independent attestation.

## Execution and validation

The initial guarded qualification was interrupted after prepare and certificate custody. A separately authorized continuation freshly replayed certificates and passed native in 1,406.98 seconds; its signed preflight then failed because the pinned source shim left an audit log in the source package. That failure and its 566-byte, two-row audit are retained. A second separately authorized service quarantined the predecessor audit, completed signed and resources, captured its 849-byte, three-row audit after group cleanup, and restored the 34-file source inventory. Its controller reported 651.53 seconds and a sampled peak of 650,571,776 bytes; the earlier continuation controller reported 1,444.50 seconds and a sampled peak of 1,267,863,552 bytes. Samples are lower observations, not complete cost accounting. These separate service attempts are not a cold six-stage replay.

Local artifact checks passed: normal and optimized read-only integrity, 985 pinned files, eight metadata mutation controls, ten native/certificate receipt mutation controls, eight audit controls, and fresh offline materialization checking all 502 mapped files, the 300-file runtime freeze, and 104 plus 14 nested paths. Default `INTEGRITY.py` checks artifact and receipt integrity without scientific execution. The optional explicit fresh six-stage command uses a disclosed path-adapted runtime application and isolated byte-pinned shim while retaining first-gate evidence. That exported scientific replay has not been run.

The following commands passed at the actual published HEAD:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-contact902-1091-on7624 --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-contact902-1091-on7624
```

The registered command performs artifact integrity only; it does not rerun the scientific application.

This work used substantial OpenAI Pro and Codex assistance; the author observations are not independent human or formal verification.

1. Independently review the fixed source, certificate relations, complete signed application, and the recorded service and source custody. The package's pinned evidence and read-only integrity command are the first step; a matching Linux/systemd environment is needed for the optional fresh qualification.
2. Determine whether a provider satisfies common U's full private-extent and finite-tariff obligations, or whether #7624's original premise implies them. Neither has been established; begin with the complete charged lifecycle item and the scalar/precision bounds.
3. Assess conditional frontier eligibility only after substantive independent review and supplier-premise assessment. Publication itself changes no selected record.

**Review request:** Please independently assess this exact artifact and its conditional frontier eligibility if the explicitly stronger common U is accepted. This request does not authorize a merge or a selected-frontier change.
